name: CISA AA22-138B VMWare Workspace (TA2)
desc: Threat Actor 2 exploited VMWare Workspace ONE Access through various methods

acts.d: multiple GET requests to VMWare Workspace ONE Access to obtain RCE, upload binaries, and upload webshells
Attackers attempted to download a webshell
Attackers downloaded 2 copies of a webshell
POST requests used to communicate with webshells; commands and output were encrypted with XOR key
Attackers downloaded a reverse SOCKS proxy

acts.n: File and Directory Permissions Modification: Linux and Mac File and Directory…
acts.d: GET request with chmod to change permissions of hidden file in /tmp directory
